Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original Petal app character, isolated transparent square raster.
Create a highly simplified FLAT GRAPHIC adult woman waving hello. This is editorial vector-style art assembled from a small number of perfectly smooth SOLID COLOR SHAPES, as if drawn with a pen tool and uniform SVG fills. NOT a realistic cartoon, watercolor, detailed line drawing or shaded fashion sketch.
One warm brown-skinned adult woman with a single deep-plum hair silhouette (rounded bun + one broad fringe, absolutely no wispy flyaway strands), two tiny dot eyes and a short curved mouth. Rose oversized shirt represented by three simple filled shapes, soft-white top, blush wide-leg trousers represented by two simple smooth leg silhouettes. A couple of muted-plum short lines describe the pose; no clothing wrinkles. Soft-white shoes. Full body, slight three-quarter turn, open hand softly waving, other hand relaxed by her side. Adult proportions and confident relaxed posture.
Every colored surface must be one perfectly uniform flat fill. Exact color anchors: Rose #B83D70, Blush #FCE8EF, Soft white #FFF7FA, Deep plum #33252D, Muted plum #745D69, plus one uniform warm brown skin fill. NO shading of any kind, gradients, lighting, texture, grain, outlines around all the shapes or white exterior keyline. Geometric cut-paper silhouette.
Character occupies ONLY the central 70 percent of the height, with 15 percent empty transparent padding at top and bottom and ample side padding. All feet and hands visible. No ground line, chair, backdrop blob, panel, ornament, text, logo, watermark, reward or clinical meaning. Truly transparent alpha with clean edges, no white residue or speckles. Original premium flat adult-health product illustration, readable when small.
